prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women, one seated on a stone throne and one kneeling at her feet.

#1: a real adult Romanian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, sultry, soft rose-gold hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish.
#1: Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
#1: Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic — a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
#1: Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the flagstone floor on its own side in front of her, her arms stretched down and slightly apart. Pose: kneeling upright on both knees on the flagstone floor at the foot of the throne, facing the camera, her shoulders drawn back, her chin lifted, her arms stretched down and slightly forward by the chains, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#1: Footwear: pointed clear stiletto pumps, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.

#2: a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, waist-length braids copper red hair — wearing a micro police costume of a minimal black leather bustier of two small opaque molded cups with a silver badge on one strap, a black leather micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, a wide belt with silver handcuffs at her hip and a black peaked police cap, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. She wears a wide black leather collar with a polished steel ring at the front, snug around her neck. She sits tall on the throne with her legs crossed at the knee, a slender black leather riding crop with a small flat leather tip resting across her knee in her right hand, her left hand resting on the stone armrest. Pose: seated upright on the stone throne facing the camera, her legs crossed at the knee, her chin lifted, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#2: Footwear: pointed stiletto pumps made of glossy black leather, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy black leather with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.

Environment: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with a heavy carved stone throne with high stone arms and a high stone back set against a rough-cut stone block wall, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the seated woman and the kneeling woman both completely visible from their feet to the top of their heads, with the stone walls, the vaulted ceiling and the flagstone floor around them at normal human scale. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
